items.title: Royal Air Maroc Business Class Boeing 787 Review: The World’s Worst Flat Bed?
items.why: A reviewer calls Royal Air Maroc's 787 business class flat bed the worst they have flown, citing no Wi-Fi and slow service.

items.title: Royal Air Maroc Business Class Boeing 737 Review: Good For A Short Hop
items.why: A review finds Royal Air Maroc's 737 business cabin roomy and well fed on a short Malaga to Casablanca route, but dated and service is cold.
